prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object visible, approach and grab it, check properties, do task, otherwise move and scan. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = MoveRobot    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = DoSpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			DO ApproachObject
	ELSE
		DO GrabObject
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO DoSpecificTask
	END
